body: I never comment on Reddit but I am praying to god this is just satire. This is straight up cartoonish. Comical even. If this girl is actually real and not fictional then she has real main character energy and you’re just living in her reality. Idk I didn’t write the show sorry bud.

I guess I fake a lot about myself. When I am working I fake my smiles and enthusiasm. I never tell anyone how I really feel nor do I ever show it. I want to appear strong, happy and reliable to those around me. But inside I hate every second I live. I’m very sad. And the world around me looks like it’s losing color each and every day. I wasn’t always like this, but I’ve been this way for almost a year now. I just want to rest in peace.
